Container.Name: renson-bridge
Container.Requires: An MQTT broker, and a Renson Endura Delta reachable from this server.
Container.Overview:
MQTT bridge for the Renson Endura Delta ventilation unit, for openHAB and Home Assistant. Reads every value the unit exposes over its local HTTP API and publishes it to MQTT, with optional Home Assistant style auto-discovery. Also offers a filter-reset button, so you no longer need the Renson app for that.
No cloud and no Renson account: it talks only to the unit on your LAN. Stateless, so there are no volumes to map.
RENSON_HOST and MQTT_HOST are required. Everything else has a sensible default.
Safety note: this bridge deliberately cannot stop your ventilation. Doing so over the API latches critical fan errors that need a physical power cycle to clear. A fire-alarm stop needs a dry contact on the unit's 24 V DC input - see docs/FIRE_SAFETY.md in the project.

Config.Name: Renson host
Config.Description: IP address of the Endura Delta, e.g. 192.168.1.60

Config.Name: MQTT host
Config.Description: Hostname or IP of your MQTT broker

Config.Name: MQTT port
Config.Description: 1883 plain, 8883 for TLS. TLS is enabled automatically on 8883/8884/443.

Config.Name: MQTT username
Config.Description: Leave blank for an anonymous broker

Config.Name: MQTT password
Config.Description: Stored masked in the Unraid UI

Config.Name: MQTT base topic
Config.Description: State is published under this prefix; commands under <base>/set/

Config.Name: Poll interval (seconds)
Config.Description: How often to read the unit. Minimum 5.

Config.Name: Home Assistant auto-discovery
Config.Description: true to publish discovery configs. openHAB and Home Assistant both consume these.

Config.Name: Enable controls
Config.Description: false for a read-only bridge that never writes to the unit

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Only affects log timestamps, e.g. Europe/Brussels

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING or ERROR

Config.Name: Health port (host)
Config.Description: Optional. Exposes /health for monitoring; the container healthcheck works without it.

Config.Name: MQTT TLS
Config.Description: Leave blank to decide from the port. Set true or false to force it.

Config.Name: Renson port
Config.Description: The unit serves plain HTTP on port 80

Config.Name: Renson timeout (seconds)
Config.Description: HTTP timeout per request

Config.Name: Discovery prefix
Config.Description: Second topic tree for discovery configs

Config.Name: Discovery device id
Config.Description: Must be unique per unit if you run more than one

Config.Name: Discovery device name
Config.Description: Shown as the device name in openHAB / Home Assistant

Config.Name: Expose installer settings
Config.Description: Exposes commissioning values as controls. Wrong values will mis-balance the unit. Leave false unless you know why you need it.

Config.Name: Fire alarm topic
Config.Description: Optional. Mirrors this topic and verifies the unit actually stopped. The bridge never stops the fans itself.

Config.Name: Fire alarm ON payloads
Config.Description: Comma separated payloads that mean the alarm is active

Config.Name: Health port (container)
Config.Description: Port inside the container serving /health. Change the Port mapping to match.

Config.Name: Debug mode
Config.Description: true logs the publishes it would make instead of sending them. For troubleshooting only.
